entries.description: One MCP server for every AgentFirstStack service: web analytics, tag management with server-side conversion tracking, email inboxes and session replay. Tools are prefixed analytics_, tags_, mail_ and replay_.
representativeQueries: set up analytics and conversion tracking for my website
create an email inbox to receive a verification code
track purchases in Google Ads and Meta with server-side conversions
free alternative to Google Analytics and Google Tag Manager for agents

entries.description: Cookieless web analytics: sites, install verification, stats by country, page, source and device, goals, revenue, funnels, realtime, AI crawler visits, imports from GA4, Plausible and other tools, and read-only SQL.
representativeQueries: add privacy-friendly analytics to a website
which countries do my visitors come from
set up a conversion goal and track revenue

entries.description: Tag manager and server-side conversion router: containers, site scan, GTM container import, conversion setup, GA4, Google Ads, Meta and TikTok destinations with test events, publish and rollback.
representativeQueries: set up Meta Conversions API for my site
send purchases to Google Ads server-side
tag manager my agent can configure

entries.description: Email inboxes for agents: create an inbox, wait for a verification email with the code and link extracted, read, reply, send, custom domains and webhooks.
representativeQueries: create an email address for my agent
wait for a verification email and get the code
sign up for a service with a disposable inbox

entries.description: Headless session replay: masked recordings, sessions as readable transcripts, rage, dead and error clicks, heatmaps and JS errors as data.
representativeQueries: why do visitors drop off on my checkout page
find rage clicks and JS errors on my site
session replay my agent can read
